name: Open WebUI

lifecycle.note: Official container supports headless first-admin creation on an empty database; model connections require separate configuration.

security: Keep the first-start admin password and persistent WEBUI_SECRET_KEY private; protect accounts, conversation history, provider keys, and tool integrations.
pitfalls: A chat UI can expose a privately bound model API if ingress is misconfigured.
Headless admin creation applies only to an empty user database; later restarts do not reset an existing password.
API keys require an enabled global setting, are user-scoped, and creating another key replaces the old one.
